Three-rod coiled basket, foundation of willow shoots sewn with sedge. Coiled to the left. Trimmed with clam shell disc beads and inset black quail topknot feathers (LOPHORTYX CALIFORNICUS) around rim, covered with green,  blue, yellow and red feathers.  Yellow from meadow lark (STURNELLLA NEGLECTA), green from mallard (original record states peacock), red from wing of redwing blackbird (original record states head of woodpecker), blue from bluebird or blue jay.

Gift or ceremonial basket, three-rod coil, foundation of willow shoots sewn with sedge and bulrush root, giving design of triangles in black. Coiled to the left. Decorated with white glass beads and tufts of red woodpecker (MELANERPES FORMICIVORUS) feathers, in a style characteristic of ceremonial baskets; earlier examples were decorated with beads of clam shell.  [?LMM 1990 9]
